parameters.query:
SELECT 
  t.id AS task_id, 
  t.title, 
  t.story_points, 
  t.priority,
  COALESCE(m.productivity_score, 100.00) AS productivity_score,
  p.start_date AS project_start_date
FROM tasks t
JOIN projects p ON p.id = t.project_id
LEFT JOIN members m ON m.id = t.assignee_id
WHERE t.project_id = '{{ $json.body.project_id }}'
ORDER BY 
  CASE t.priority
    WHEN 'URGENT' THEN 1
    WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2
    WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3
    WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END ASC,
  t.created_at ASC;

UPDATE tasks 
SET due_date = '{{ $json.due_date }}'::timestamptz, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = '{{ $json.task_id }}'
RETURNING id, title, due_date;
